# Fusionify Digital Solutions

> Partner transformasi digital untuk UMKM, startup, dan enterprise di Indonesia. Web development, automation bots, digital systems, cloud support, dan project services dengan pendekatan automation-first.

Fusionify Digital Solutions (PT Fusionify Digital Store) membangun solusi end-to-end: website modern, bot WhatsApp/Telegram, sistem internal terintegrasi, infrastruktur cloud, dan layanan project on-demand.

## Pages

- [Beranda](/): Ringkasan layanan, portofolio, dan ekosistem produk Fusionify.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Studi kasus proyek nyata untuk klien UMKM dan enterprise.
- [Ekosistem Produk](/ecosystem): Produk dan komunitas yang dibangun Fusionify.

## Services

- [Web Development](/services/web-development): Landing page, company profile, e-commerce, dan custom web app.
- [Automation & Bots](/services/automation-bots): Bot WhatsApp, Telegram, dan workflow automation untuk operasional.
- [Digital Systems](/services/digital-systems): Sistem internal (CRM, ERP ringan, dashboard) terintegrasi.
- [Cloud Support](/services/cloud-support): Setup, migrasi, dan maintenance infrastruktur cloud.
- [Project Services](/services/project-services): Layanan project on-demand untuk kebutuhan teknis lainnya.

## Portfolio highlights

- [SMK Pionir](/portfolio/smk-pionir): Website sekolah modern.
- [Cessa Snack](/portfolio/cessa-snack): E-commerce produk makanan.
- [TokyoShop ID](/portfolio/tokyoshop-id): Toko online lintas kategori.
- [Servisku WhatsApp Bot](/portfolio/servisku-whatsapp-bot): Automasi layanan pelanggan via WhatsApp.
- [TechVenture CRM](/portfolio/techventure-crm-integration): Integrasi CRM kustom.
